name: chunk-after-explicit-start-fatal
description: the two spellings do not mix within one item: a message opened by TEXT_MESSAGE_START is continued explicitly, so a TEXT_MESSAGE_CHUNK naming its id is the first chunk of a new item under an id that is already open, and fatal. Local to this repository: the specification states the rule and the upstream corpus has no stream for it
kill: let a chunk that names an explicitly opened message continue that message instead of opening the id again

expect.errorContains: A text message with ID 'chunk-after-start-m1' is already in progress
